eyebrow: Americans for Immigrant Justice · Dreamers Video Initiative (self-recorded) · Sep–Oct 2026 · Gala compilation
title: We Are Dreamers
headline: Real Dreamers, in their own voices, tell the gala room what being a Dreamer made possible.
story: AIJ asked Dreamers to record five short answers: what being a Dreamer allowed them to do, how they contribute today, their dream for the future, one word, and “I am a Dreamer.” Three people have sent answers so far.

It opens on three faces saying “I am a dreamer.” Then past, present and future, one word, and one final “I am a dreamer.” No narration. No names and no places, ever: AIJ promised that to every person who sent a video.
do: Open cold on three “I am a dreamer.” lines, back to back.
Crop every frame to a clean 16:9 medium close-up. Keep it consistent.
Level-match the clips. Light noise reduction only.
Walk the folder before export. Add any new submitter in the same structure.
Put each one word on screen, big, for 1 second.
dont: No names, no cities, no places, no file names on screen. No lower thirds.
No narration, no stock, no B-roll. Only their faces.
No logo until the end card.
No music before the hook lines.
No second aspect ratio. No social version on this item.

bp_intro: Times come from the Dreamers transcript.json word times, accurate to about 0.2 s. Every file is one short answer. Frames are the Doc Assets clip stills (one per file, time unknown). Ignore the two copies: “Copy of WIN_20260925_11_06_44_Pro.mp4” and MLD/IMUBSY~Q.MOV.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer A, long dark hair, white shirt, bedroom behind, smiling to camera
rows.visual: Dreamer A, webcam, eyes to lens. Cut in on the first word.
rows.motion: Nothing on screen but the face. No logo, no title, no name.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer B, man in a dark jacket and tie, white wall with swirls behind
Dreamer C, blond bob, striped shirt, light wall behind, smiling

voice.src: MLD/IMG_8637.MOV 00:01.04–00:01.92 (IMUBSY~Q.MOV in the same folder is a copy: ignore it)

rows.music: Music enters after the third line. One emotional, building track.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer A speaking, eyes half closed, bedroom behind
rows.visual: Dreamer A. Crop to a clean 16:9 medium close-up. 2–3% push-in allowed.
rows.motion: Section word <q>PAST</q> at 00:04, lower left, small, 2 s. Filson Pro Heavy, white. Optional.

voice.quote: Being a Dreamer has allowed me to rise beyond the limits placed on me and become someone who contributes, creates, and cares for the community that raised me.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer B seated, dark jacket and tie, white wall with swirls

voice.quote: Being a Dreamer has allowed me to graduate from college, become an immigration attorney, and become an advocate for immigrant families.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer C speaking with her hands, striped shirt
rows.visual: Dreamer C. Her answer is long: keep it whole if the pace allows. It turns from loss to a fight for health equity.

voice.quote: Being a dreamer allowed me to turn the heartbreak of losing my mother without healthcare into a fight for health equity. It gave me the opportunity to earn a master’s from Harvard, buy a home with my husband, and most recently help my brother attend college.

rows.music: Small lift on “fight for health equity”.

rows.motion: Section word <q>PRESENT</q>, lower left, 2 s. Optional.

voice.quote: I am proud to contribute to this country by turning my lived experience into action, helping shape policies and stories that move us towards dignity and belonging.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer B seated, speaking to camera

voice.quote: I’m proud to contribute to this country by helping immigrant families pursue their dreams and build better futures.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer A smiling with eyes closed
rows.visual: Dreamer A. Let “I’ve always called home” land.
rows.motion: Section word <q>FUTURE</q>, lower left, 2 s. Optional.

voice.quote: My dream for the future is simple. Stability, dignity, and the freedom to keep contributing to the country I’ve always called home.
My dream is to keep giving back, continue to bless this country, and inspire others to do the same.

rows.motion: The word as big centred text over her face: <q>rooted.</q> Filson Pro Heavy, white. 1 s.

rows.frame_alt: Dreamer C smiling, eyes to camera
rows.visual: Dreamer C, 1 s. Dreamer B sent no one-word answer.
rows.motion: Big centred text: <q>Unbroken.</q> Same style. 1 s.

rows.visual: One single “I am a dreamer.” — the strongest delivery of the three, picked by ear. Not a stack. Hold 1 s of silence on the face after the line.
rows.music: Music drops out for the 1 s hold.

rows.visual: AIJ 30 Years logo lockup on white or navy #163966.
rows.motion: Logo from the brand assets Andrés sent (25 Sep). The logo appears here only.
rows.music: Music returns for the card. Last note, 1 s fade.

Not measured, check the meters. Webcam and phone mics: level-match every clip.

The export title holds only the Edit Key.

client_note: Why this matters: these people trusted AIJ with their faces on a promise of no names. One slip breaks that promise in front of the whole gala room.
